content.short: Spot new tokens, follow smart-money wallets and snipe launches from GMGN's memecoin trading terminal.
content.description: GMGN is built for fast-moving token markets on Solana, Ethereum and other chains. It lists new launches as they appear, flags holder concentration and other risk signals, and highlights wallets with strong track records so you can follow what they buy. Trades can be placed straight from the terminal, copied from tracked wallets, or left to automation while you are away. It runs on the web and as a mobile app. It scans launchpads such as pump.fun, four.meme, Raydium and letsbonk, checks every new token for burned liquidity, honeypots and mint authority, and measures insider, bundle and developer holdings before you buy. It now covers Solana, BSC, Base and Ethereum.
content.meta: Discover new tokens, follow smart-money wallets and snipe or copy trades from one terminal. Explore GMGN on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
